notes.design: paired by seed against base; 10 seeds; ai2027/medium/leader; bootstrap CI = percentile, 4000 resamples of the paired seeds; pSign = exact two-sided sign test on discordant pairs; ASI paired stats use only seeds where both base and set reached ASI (asiReach counts every seed: fasterOrGained = set reached ASI earlier or reached it where base never did); evidence.class: inert = identical to base on all 10 seeds, clear = min exact p <= 0.01, suggestive < 0.05, noise otherwise (min over win, SC, SAR, ASI-reach tests; ~312 tests so a few false hits are expected); rank = position in the top-15 table of BOTS-RESULTS.md
